paper_metadata.title: Enhancement of strength-ductility trade-off in Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 high entropy alloy through annealing twins

evidence.quote: Here, we designed a single FCC phase Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 HEA with low stacking fault energy
The as-cast sheet was homogenized at 1250 ◦C for 2 h, water-quenched (referred to as AC).

samples.material_state: annealed at 900 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: The rolled samples were annealed at 900 ◦C for 30 min or at 1000 ◦C for 15 min, water-quenched (referred to as CR-900 and CR-1000).

samples.material_state: annealed at 1000 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: The rolled samples were annealed at 900 ◦C for 30 min or at 1000 ◦C for 15 min, water-quenched (referred to as CR-900 and CR-1000).

Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 HEAs were prepared by vacuum arc melting. Each ingot was turned over and remelted five times to ensure chemical uniformity, and then dropped onto a slab-shaped copper mold with a size of 10 × 6 × 60 mm3.
The as-cast sheet was homogenized at 1250 ◦C for 2 h, water-quenched (referred to as AC).
Then cold-rolled at room temperature to a thickness reduction of 75 %.

evidence.quote: As shown in the phase diagram of Fig. 8 (a), the structure of the sample is completely composed of FCC phase. The sample almost completed complete recrystallization.

attributes.phase_fraction: heterogeneous mixture of recrystallized and non-recrystallized grains

evidence.quote: After annealing at 900 ◦C, the grain structure is mainly composed of recrystallized grains and non-recrystallized grains (deformed grains), showing heterogeneous characteristics.

phases_and_microstructures.name: equiaxed recrystallized grain
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 1000 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: After annealing at 1000 ◦C, the deformed microstructure is completely replaced by refined equiaxed recrystallized grains ... The average grain size of the sample is 19.43 μm.

phases_and_microstructures.name: annealing twin
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 1000 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: Compared with CR-900 alloy, a large area of annealing twins is formed in the recrystallized grains of CR-1000 alloy, and the twin density is about 42.6 %.

phases_and_microstructures.name: dislocation
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 900 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: The high-density dislocations are concentrated in the deformed grains or distributed along the deformed grains. The average GND value of the CR-900 sample is 14.86 × 1014 m2

phases_and_microstructures.name: dislocation
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 1000 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: The average GND value of the CR-1000 sample is 0.62 × 1014 m2, indicating that the dislocation density is lower than that of the CR-900 alloy

phases_and_microstructures.material_state: annealed at 900 C after cold rolling

evidence.quote: the proportion of low angle grain boundaries (LAGBs, gray lines are shown in Fig. 7 (a–c)) in the sample is still high ... low angle grain boundaries (LAGBs account for 64.9 %) dominate.
